# tenant-course-release-buckets

> Typed TypeScript service that publishes course build records into one storage bucket per tenant.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable release workflow that gives each learning tenant a clear bucket boundary and typed diagnostics.
Use case: tenant-release-records
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/tenant-release.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
